name: Exp_ColorFisher_m11
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorFisher_m11 indicator, a Fisher Transform-based oscillator that identifies overbought and oversold market conditions. It enters long positions when the Fisher oscillator crosses upward from oversold levels and enters short positions when it crosses downward from overbought levels. The EA systematically executes mean reversion trades with configurable lot sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorFisher_m11指标进行交易，这是一个基于Fisher变换的振荡器，用于识别市场超买和超卖状态。当Fisher振荡器从超卖区域向上穿越时开多仓，从超买区域向下穿越时开空仓。该EA系统性地执行均值回归交易，具有可配置的手数和止损/止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Fisher变换振荡器，Fisher变换是一种将概率分布转换为近似高斯分布的数学变换，能够将价格数据转换为在超买和超卖之间摆动的振荡指标。入场条件为：当Fisher振荡器从负值区域（超卖）向上穿越信号线时开多仓；当Fisher振荡器从正值区域（超买）向下穿越信号线时开空仓。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈水平，以及Fisher振荡器反向交叉时的信号平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可通过参数设定交易手数。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但缺乏基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略属于典型的均值回归类型，适合震荡市场，但在强趋势行情中可能遭受连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Fisher Transform oscillator, which is a mathematical transformation that converts probability distributions into approximately Gaussian distributions, swinging price data between overbought and oversold levels. Entry conditions are: go long when the Fisher oscillator crosses above its signal line from negative territory (oversold), and go short when it crosses below its signal line from positive territory (overbought). Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as signal-based exits when the Fisher oscillator makes a reverse crossover. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user can set the trading volume through input parameters. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters, but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account balance or equity. The overall strategy is a classic mean reversion type suitable for ranging markets, but may suffer consecutive losses during strong trending conditions.

parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分不同EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Unique EA order identifier preventing conflicts

pros: Fisher变换振荡器具有高灵敏度，能快速捕捉价格转折点，在震荡市中表现优异
策略逻辑简洁明了，参数较少，便于理解和优化
基于数学变换的指标信号客观，避免了主观判断带来的情绪干扰
pros_en: The Fisher Transform oscillator has high sensitivity and can quickly capture price turning points, performing well in ranging markets
The strategy logic is simple and clear with few parameters, making it easy to understand and optimize
Signals based on mathematical transformation are objective, avoiding emotional interference from subjective judgment
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易遭受连续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤机制
默认止损和止盈为0，用户若不手动设置则交易无保护，风险极高
固定手数仓位管理无法根据市场波动性和账户资金动态调整，资金利用效率低
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy is prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets, lacking a trend filter mechanism
Default stop loss and take profit are 0, leaving trades unprotected if the user does not manually set them, which is extremely risky
Fixed lot position sizing cannot dynamically adjust based on market volatility and account equity, resulting in low capital efficiency
improvements: 增加趋势过滤机制（如均线方向判断），在强趋势行情中避免逆势开仓
实现基于账户权益和ATR的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数方式
improvements_en: Add a trend filter mechanism (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend entries during strong trending markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity and ATR to replace the fixed lot approach

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，未设置时交易完全无保护，可能导致巨额亏损
均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能连续逆势建仓造成严重回撤
risk_points_en: Default stop loss and take profit are 0, leaving trades completely unprotected when not set, potentially leading to massive losses
Mean reversion strategy may repeatedly open counter-trend positions during trending markets, causing severe drawdowns
